Application requirements
About the course
Curriculum planning
Minimum Required Credits for Graduation: 18 credits.
1. Required Courses (not included in the minimum graduation credits):
Thesis (Ph.D.), Seminar (at least 4 semesters), Special Project (required for every semester), etc.
2. Required Electives (at least 9 Credits):
[Machine Learning Courses]:
Machine Learning (4 credits, 921 U2620), Machine Learning (3 credits, 922 U0960), Artificial Intelligence (3 credits, 922 U3020), Applied Deep Learning (3 credits, 922 U4340). A maximum of 4 credits from the above courses can be counted toward the required elective credits.
[Other Required Elective Courses]:
Statistical Foundations of Data Science (I) (3 credits, 946 U0040), Computational Methods for Data Science (3 credits, 946 U0090), and High-Performance Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Systems (3 credits, 922 U4620), which are taught in Chinese.
3. Elective Courses:
Courses offered by the program, the division of Electrical Engineering, the division of Computer Science, the Department of Mathematics, or the Graduate Institute of Applied Mathematical Sciences can be counted as elective credits for graduation. Undergraduate courses are not counted toward the credits, except for those with course codes starting with “U.” There are sufficient English-taught courses available for elective subjects.
For more details, please refer to the NTU course map and the Data Science Degree Program Curriculum Planning Map.
Future map
By integrating training in electrical engineering, information science, mathematics and statistics, high-performance computing, and practical problem applications, this program aims to cultivate individuals capable of conducting high-quality research and teaching in academia, as well as engaging in pioneering advanced research and value-added work in the industry.
Department info
Web URL
https://ds.ntu.edu.tw/en/home/
Introduction
With the booming development of the information technology industry, various data for computation and storage are rapidly generated and accumulated. The rich information within big data far exceeds the scope covered by traditional mathematical and statistical modeling.
Data science is an interdisciplinary field composed of three major dimensions: computer science, mathematics and statistics, and domain knowledge. The research and teaching in the field of data science by National Taiwan University and Academia Sinica have long been internationally renowned and influential.
This program is a cross-disciplinary collaboration between National Taiwan University and Academia Sinica, with joint support and participation in planning and nurturing students. Interested students are welcome to apply for either the Master's or Ph.D. program.

Application documents
Passport or ID
[Details]
Please provide a scanned copy of your passport; if you don't have a passport, please upload any national ID with your name on it such as ID card, driver's license, etc., that clearly indicates your full name and nationality.
Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) (if applicable)
[Details]
If you are a current or past holder of an ARC in Taiwan, please upload a copy here.
Graduation Certificate of highest degree awarded - Original version
[Details]
Please submit an official Graduation Certificate issued by the school/university. Students graduating in the current year shall submit a Certificate of Expected Graduation or a Certificate of Enrollment officially issued by the school/university.
Full Transcript of highest degree awarded (including records of each year and explanation of grading system) - Original version
[Details]
High school graduates must submit academic transcripts for grades 10 to 12. Graduates whose graduating year is academically equivalent to the second grade of a senior secondary school in Taiwan of a comparable academic level and nature, must submit transcripts for grades 7 to 11.
Graduation Certificate of highest degree awarded - Translated version
[Details]
Translated version is required if the original one is not in Chinese or English.
Full Transcript of highest degree awarded (including records of each year and explanation of grading system) - Translated version
[Details]
Translated version is required if the original one is not in Chinese or English.
Financial Statement
[Details]
All applicants shall provide a bank statement, issued by a bank within the past 3 months, showing a minimum balance equivalent to NTD 200,000 in savings deposit.
Scholarship recipients shall provide proof of scholarship. Applicants who have been granted scholarships or assistantships by NTU professors or departments/graduate institutes may submit relevant proof instead of a bank statement.
*If the bank account is not under the applicant's name, please submit the bank statement and the financial supporter's signed guarantee of financial support.
*If an applicant's bank account statement has insufficient funds, please submit the applicant's and financial supporter's bank statements with the total savings equivalent to NTD 200,000 within 3 months. Besides, the financial supporter shall also provide his or her signed guarantee of financial support.
Documents required by department
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Statement of purpose (Please specify interested research topic)
[Details]
The statement of purpose should include your research interests and list 2-3 faculty members of interest within this program.
Additional supporting documents for review ( if applicable)
EECS Global Elite Cultivation Fellowship Application form ( if applicable)
[Details]
Applicants for the "EECS Global Elite Cultivation Fellowship" must complete and upload the application form.
Recommendation letter x 2
Interview / Oral exam
The committee will conduct a written review of all applications. Applicants may be contacted individually for an interview if necessary.
Written exam
None
Additional notes
* Incomplete applications will not be processed or reviewed by the program.
* Please list 2-3 faculty members of interest in your Research Proposal (Statement of Purpose). For details regarding their research areas, please visit our program website.
* A minimum of two and a maximum of three recommendation letters are required.
* Please note that Academia Sinica Fellowships for Doctoral Students are not available to candidates admitted through this admission track.
Scholarship from college or department
Name : EECS Global Elite Cultivation Fellowship
Amount : -Master: TWD 480,000 (~USD 15,500) for 2 years.
-PhD: TWD 960,000 (~USD 31,000) for 4 years.
-2-month internship in leading companies.
-Pre-employment opportunity in leading companies
Advantages:
-Actively participate in academia and industry collaboration.
-Closely engage with top professors in NTU EECS.
-Internship and job offer opportunities from global leading companies.
Additional notes:
-Students who apply for the fellowship are required to download and complete the application form.
-Top Talents have the opportunity to receive BOTH EECS Global Elite Cultivation Fellowship and Outstanding International Graduate Student Scholarship.
Name : International Student Scholarship by College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science of National Taiwan University
Amount : -For doctoral student: NTD $16,000 monthly living cost.
-For MS student: NTD $12,000 monthly living cost
Additional notes : (1)Students awarded with scholarship for 1 semester will
receive scholarship for no more than 5 months ; Students awarded with scholarship for 1 academic year will receive scholarship for no more than 10 months.
(2)The exact number of awardees and awarded periods will be subject to the funding conditions of each year.
(3)Prospective students and Current students can apply for the College scholarship after registration under the application process announced by the College of EECS, NTU.
*In addition to the College Scholarship, please refer to the following website for the information of NTU Scholarships: https://admissions.ntu.edu.tw/apply/scholarships/
Scholarship from NTU
Please refer to NTU Overseas Student Admissions >> Apply - Degree & Non-Degree Admissions >> Scholarships - Degree Admissions for detailed information.
*International student applicants who apply through the TIGP system are only eligible for TIGP scholarships, and are not able to receive the NTU scholarships.
